subject: Social Media
title: The Punishment Doesn't Fit
description: A quick, practical guide to The Punishment Doesn't Fit.

hook.text: A scientist wore a tacky shirt on TV. The internet destroyed him. He broke down crying on live television.

buildup.text: Matt Taylor helped land a probe on a comet. Nobody remembers that. They remember the shirt controversy.

discovery.text: The shirt was tasteless. The response—career threats, death threats, global mockery—was disproportionate.

twist.text: Online mobs have one volume: maximum. A bad joke and a hate crime receive identical levels of fury.

climax.text: Proportional justice requires context. The internet destroys context. So it destroys proportionality.

punchline.text: The punishment never fits. The mob has one size.

quiz.question: Why do online mobs deliver disproportionate punishment?
